function.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific UniProt entry including sequence, annotations, functions, and cross-references.

function.name: analyze_interpro_domains
function.description: Analyze protein domains, families, and functional sites using InterPro database. Provides comprehensive domain architecture, functional annotations, and evolutionary relationships.

function.name: load_genome_file
function.description: Load genome files (FASTA/GenBank) directly with file path specification or via file dialog

function.name: get_current_state
function.description: Get the current state of the genome browser including position, visible tracks, loaded data, and session information. Use this to understand the current context before making other operations.

function.name: get_sequence
function.description: Retrieve DNA sequence for a specific genomic region. Returns the raw sequence data and basic statistics. USE THIS TOOL ONLY WHEN THE PROMPT CONTAINS THE WORD "sequence". For visualizing genomic regions, use navigate_to_position instead.

function.name: find_gene_by_name
function.description: Search for a SPECIFIC GENE by its name or locus tag (e.g., lacZ, b0062, dnaA). Use this when you know the gene identifier. For searching by functional annotation or feature type (e.g., "all kinase genes", "all tRNA"), use search_features instead. For direct navigation to a known gene, try jump_to_gene first.
